svg.title: LoanOS India — System Architecture
svg.desc: A layered architecture map of LoanOS India showing people and partner ecosystems, delivery channels, API orchestration, the domain kernel, isolated decision engines, data and evidence, platform operations, infrastructure, external systems, and cross-cutting engineering principles. Relationships: People initiate governed journeys through authorised channels; Channels submit authenticated commands and queries; API orchestration invokes tenant-scoped domain services; Domain facts request deterministic policy decisions; Decision lineage is sealed into tenant evidence; State and evidence changes drive operational events; Operational health and assurance evidence gate delivery; Certified gateways exchange with external systems.

g.text: Multi-tenant · RBI-compliance-first · deterministic decisions · evidence by construction
